title: How One Guy Saves Past Pop Hits From Extinction in the Age of Streaming

segments: Market performance and AI stock trends
United Airlines bans AI booking agents
Ukraine-Russia peace talks in Abu Dhabi
White House warns House oversight chair
Rescuing lost music for streaming services
summary.headline: CoreWeave earnings lift AI stocks; California rejects wealth tax
summary.tldr: Markets rallied behind strong AI-related earnings, while United Airlines moved to restrict AI booking bots. Meanwhile, California rejected a billionaire tax, and a London-based lawyer is successfully lobbying to bring lost music tracks to streaming platforms.

key_points.point: CoreWeave shares rose 25% following a strong earnings report, boosting other data center and chip stocks.
key_points.why_it_matters: Positive sentiment in AI-related hardware helps stabilize broader market volatility and investor confidence in the AI sector.

key_points.point: United Airlines is banning personal AI assistants from booking flights on its website due to concerns over data security and regulatory compliance.
key_points.why_it_matters: This highlights the friction between the rapid adoption of AI agents and the operational and legal constraints of established service industries.

key_points.point: California rejected a proposed billionaire wealth tax, though proponents suggest the issue may return to the ballot in 2028.
key_points.why_it_matters: The failure of this measure reflects the ongoing political and legal challenges surrounding wealth taxation in the United States.

key_points.point: A London-based lawyer has successfully lobbied to get 900 music releases back onto streaming platforms over the last 10 years.
key_points.why_it_matters: Many songs are missing from streaming due to digitization gaps, lost master tapes, or complex rights issues, rather than a lack of consumer interest.

numbers.context: The surge in CoreWeave shares after the company reported strong earnings.
The gain in the Nasdaq index during the trading session.
The number of music releases a lawyer has helped get back onto streaming platforms over the last 10 years.

summary.lesson: When digital assets like music or data are moved across platforms, ownership and rights issues often cause content to be lost or excluded, creating a gap between historical availability and modern access.
opinions_and_predictions: Some US officials believe it is a political risk for J.D. Vance to lead Iran peace talks, as he could become the face of failure if negotiations collapse.
Bernie Sanders stated that a federal billionaire wealth tax will be passed.
Paul Kieran (WSJ) notes that a federal wealth tax faces significant legal obstacles, particularly with the current Supreme Court.
